points.description: States wind speed AND temperature (of water and air) as factors affecting evaporation.
States vapour pressure (difference between saturated vapour pressure at water surface and actual vapour pressure of air) as a factor, using the term vapour pressure.
States atmospheric pressure as a factor.
States both heat storage by the water body AND water quality (e.g. salinity/dissolved solids) as factors.
points.partial_credit: Only if one of the two is stated precisely: 0.25

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need all six factors named with correct terms: wind speed, temperature of water and air, vapour pressure, atmospheric pressure, heat storage by water body, water quality. Give part marks only where a point is clearly over half stated, as set out in partial_credit. Vague wording (e.g. 'weather', 'climate', 'humidity' alone) earns nothing for that point, and a wrong extra factor (e.g. rainfall, soil type) makes the point it sits with earn zero.
